title: Little Science Series — Asset Manifest Schema
description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for LSS_manifest.json. Validates every asset entry produced by the Little Science Series image pipeline. An AI agent MUST validate the full manifest array against this schema before invoking any downstream image-generation, file-creation, or repo-push operation.
$comment:
AGENT INSTRUCTIONS — read before use:
  1. Load LSS_manifest.json and parse it as a JSON array.
  2. Run a compliant JSON Schema validator (e.g. jsonschema ≥ 4.x, Ajv ≥ 8.x) against this schema.
  3. If validation fails, halt and surface the error path(s) to the operator — do NOT proceed.
  4. If validation passes, hand each entry to the image pipeline as described in $defs/asset/properties/prompt.
  5. Write generated files to the folder tree defined in $defs/folderConvention.
  6. Never mutate manifest entries; treat the manifest as the single source of truth.

bookNumber.description: Ordinal position of the book within the Little Science Series (1 = Gravity … 6 = Heat).

bookName.description: Human-readable title of the book. Must match book_number exactly per the canonical mapping.

domain.description: Four-or-five-character domain code used in filenames and folder names.

variant.description: Asset variant. A = primary composition, B = alternate composition for the same concept.

assetType.description: STILL → rendered as PNG (static illustration). ANIM → rendered as GIF (looping animation).

filename.description: Canonical filename following the pattern LSS_B{book#}_{domain}_S{scene#}_{type}_{variant}.{ext}. Extension must be png for STILL and gif for ANIM.

prompt.description: Verbatim Imagine/image-generation prompt to be passed to the AI image pipeline. Prompts for STILL entries describe a static illustration; prompts for ANIM entries describe a looping animation and MUST include frame rate notation (e.g. '24 fps') or the word 'loop'.

asset.description: A single renderable asset entry in the Little Science Series manifest.

description: Complete ordered list of all 144 renderable assets for the Little Science Series.

contains.description: Spot-check: the manifest must contain at least one entry for every book and every asset type.
contains.$comment: Full cross-product completeness (6 books × 6 scenes × 2 variants × 2 types = 144) is enforced by minItems/maxItems combined with uniqueItems and the filename pattern.
